cause: The first connected-cage housing used one angle-limited Bevel modifier across both exterior corners and the inset grid. It produced visible corner spikes and damaged the central transition.
decision: Keep the connected cage, but test separately scoped exterior and recess bevels. Do not return to stacked fascia/recess boxes.
outcome: The follow-up vertex-group perimeter bevel also failed visual review and is documented separately; only the narrow recess treatment survived.
